blocks.md: When `latch-bc-01` binds against a sagged strike plate and `latch-sim-02` plunges into the nominal plate at …, neither failure can be repaired by training the same network for more epochs on the same dataset. Fixing an unvisited recovery state or an exploited contact solver requires changing the experience the learner sees.

questions.q: The section **Policy Training Regimes** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: A decoder chosen for multimodality must fit the proposal deadline, since latency is encoding plus every dependent decoder evaluation, so the head and evaluation count that training picks decide schedulability.
Fitting values over a fixed log and acting greedily inflates values at actions the log never executed, and conservative objectives reduce that error but cannot create support the log lacks.
A simulator's contact model decides what the optimizer learns, and a soft penalty spring lets a policy pass through contacts the real plate would resist.
Sim-to-real mismatch decomposes into dynamics, sensing, appearance, and timing channels, each sized by paired probing, and randomization covers modeled parameters but never omitted mechanisms.
